subject: Hospitality
title: Event Security and Risk Management
description: A short lesson to help you apply Event Security and Risk Management.

hook.text: A 10,000-person event requires a security plan covering crowd control, medical emergencies, fire evacuation, severe weather.

buildup.text: Event security involves access control (badges, wristbands), bag checks, surveillance cameras, trained guards.

discovery.text: Medical coverage scales with crowd size: events over 5,000 need on-site EMTs and ambulance access.

twist.text: The biggest security risk is crowd crush—not terrorism. Overcrowded exits, poor barriers.

climax.text: Post-incident investigations almost always reveal preventable failures: inadequate planning, understaffing.

punchline.text: The biggest threat isn't from outside—it's crowd crush from poor planning.

quiz.question: What is the biggest security risk at large events?
options: Crowd crush from overcrowded exits, poor barriers, and panic
